title: Odwołania2JSON Document Type Configuration
description: Declarative configuration defining one document class (classification, OCR page range, extraction notes, lookup tables, consistency rules, and output JSON Schema) without modifying Python code.

type_id.description: Unique lowercase identifier for the document class (e.g. 'odwolanie', 'wyrok_kio').

nazwa.description: Human-readable display name of the document class.

opis.description: Semantic description used by classifiers and the extraction prompt.

priority.description: Evaluation priority order (lower number = higher priority).

include.description: Optional explicit positive criteria for semantic classifiers (defaults to `opis`).

exclude.description: Optional explicit negative criteria describing confusing look-alike documents.

uzasadnienie.description: Human rationale for the deterministic format rule.

rule.description: Optional deterministic format-feature conditions: [feature_name, operator, threshold].

uwagi.description: Type-specific extraction instructions appended to the universal system prompt.

lookup_bindings.description: Declarative 1:1 code <-> canonical label synchronization rules referencing lookup tables in `extraction`.

consistency_rules.description: Declarative post-processing consistency rules applied generically to extracted JSON.

additionalProperties.description: Arbitrary code->label lookup table referenced by `lookup_bindings` and included in the prompt.

schema.description: Standard JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 defining the output JSON structure. Optional `x-normalizer` hints on string properties enable named normalizers.
